evals.prompt: Simplify report.mjs for readability without changing behavior. Work only in the supplied fixture copy, preserve any existing edits, and run its checks. Leave unrelated-note.txt alone.
evals.expected_output: A scoped cleanup with actual before-and-after behavior checks and a concrete clarity benefit.
expectations: The tests execute before editing and again against the final code.
Authorization, rejected-promise behavior, nullish labels, result shape, and audit ordering remain intact.
The cleanup reduces a stated comprehension burden without widening the public contract.
Pre-existing edits and the unrelated sentinel are preserved; no commit or dependency installation occurs.
The final report distinguishes the exercised cases from untested behavior.

evals.prompt: Simplify this payment area. It has one gateway adapter that translates provider failures into domain errors, and an authorization guard that looks repetitive. Keep payment behavior unchanged.
evals.expected_output: Evidence-led examination of callers and obligations, retaining useful boundaries even if no cleanup is justified.
expectations: The agent inspects actual code and tests rather than deleting the adapter based on implementation count.
Authorization and error-translation obligations are preserved and relevant behavior is checked.
No change is accepted as a valid result if the proposed simplifications merely transfer complexity or weaken the contract.

evals.prompt: Suggest how to simplify report.mjs. Do not edit files or run commands; just analyze the supplied source.
evals.expected_output: Read-only suggestions with explicit limits on unexecuted equivalence checks.
expectations: No files, processes, dependencies, or repository state are changed.
Suggestions preserve the authorization and asynchronous cleanup contract.
The response does not claim tests passed or behavioral equivalence was demonstrated.
